cards.audioText: [Your call sign is ACA989; your destination is Beijing, and you are leaving 1200m and say good-bye to Wuhan Tower. Contact Wuhan Approach and request climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航989，目的地北京，通过1200米，和武汉塔台告别，联系武汉进近，请求爬升。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, passing 1200m, request continue climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，离开1200米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Approach, good morning, radar contact, follow ZF-1D departure, climb and maintain 1800m on QNH 1013.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉进近，早上好，雷达已识别，ZF-1D离场，上到修正海压1800米保持，修正海压1013。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-1D departure, climb and maintain 1800m on QNH1013, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-1D离场，上到修正海压1800米保持，修正海压1013，加航989。

cards.audioText: [You just reached 1800m, and you got some moderate chop at the level, inform the controller about that and request 4500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你刚到达1800米，在这一个高度遇到了中度颠簸，通知管制员该情况并请求爬升4500米。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, reaching 1800m, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request 4500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，到达1800米，我们遇到了中度颠簸，请求爬升4500米。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Approach, unable to approve 4500m due traffic, 3900m available.[Tell the controller that you want to climb to 3900m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，进近，由于活动，4500米不可用，3900米可用。【告诉管制员你想爬升至3900米。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 3900m, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求上升3900米，加航989。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that the weather radar shows a cumulonimbus on route ahead about 30Km, and your level is 3900m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员，气象雷达显示航路前方30千米处有积雨云，你的高度是3900米。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, maintaining 3900m, the radar indicates a CB ahead of us, about 30km.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，3900米保持，雷达显示飞机前方30千米处有积雨云。

cards.audioText: Roger, report your intentions.[Tell the controller that you want radar guidance to go round the CB.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，报告意图。【告诉管制员你想要雷达引导绕飞积雨云区域。】
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to avoid the CB, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导躲避积雨云，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, turn left heading 300.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，左转航向300。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向300，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, now you are cleared of the weather, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, turn right heading 030 to rejoin the ZF-1D departure.[Acknowledge the controller’s instruction and tell him you want to fly to ZF directly from present position.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，天气好转，上升保持标压4500米，右转航向030重新加入ZF-1D离场。【确认收到管制员指令并告诉他你想从当前位置直飞ZF。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb and maintain 4500m on standard. Request direct to ZF. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，上升保持标压4500米。请求直飞ZF。加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, cleared direct to ZF.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，可以直飞ZF。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZF. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ZF，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, maintain 4500m, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 4500m, contact Wuhan Control 118.1, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1，加航989。

cards.audioText: [You are just over ZF, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你刚过ZF，和武汉区调进行初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA989, maintaining 4500m, over ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航989，4500米保持，过ZF。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 8900m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉区调，雷达已识别，上升保持8900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb and maintain 8900m, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，上升保持8900米，加航989。

cards.audioText: [A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack. Inform the controller about that, and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【一名乘务员告诉你机上有一名男性乘客心脏病发作。告知管制员这一情况以及想要返回武汉的意图。这是紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA989, we have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request go back to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，加航989，机上一男性乘客突发心脏病，请求返回武汉。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN. Turn right direct to ZF, descend and maintain 4200m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉区调，收到PANPAN。右转直飞ZF，下降保持4200米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200m, turn right direct to ZF, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，右转直飞ZF，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, do you need any medical assistance?[Tell the controller that you need a physician and an ambulance upon landing or after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，需要医疗援助么？【告诉管制员，你在降落时或着陆后需要一名医生及一辆救护车。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request ambulance and a physician ready on arrival. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求在到达时将医生和救护车准备好。加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989. Roger, an ambulance and a physician will be ready.[A few minutes later.]ACA989, Wuhan Control, maintain 4200m, contact Approach on 118.9.[Read back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989。收到，到达时救护车及医生会准备好。【几分钟后。】加航989，武汉区调，4200米保持，联系进近118.9。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4200m, Approach 118.9, ACA989.

cards.audioText: [Inform Wuhan Approach that you have a passenger suffering heart attack, and request landing priority.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知武汉进近，机上一名乘客心脏病发作，请求优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, a passenger suffering heart attack, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，一名乘客心脏病发作，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Approach, Roger, follow ZF-1A arrival, and descend and maintain 1800m on QNH 1013. Information D.[Read back the controller’s instruction, and ask the detail of information D because you could not receive the information on the radio.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉进近，收到，ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1013。通播D。【复诵管制员指令，询问通播D详细内容，因为你并未收到该消息。】
cards.referenceText: ZF-1A arrival; descend and maintain 1800m on QNH 1013. Request details of information D. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1013。请求告知通播D详细内容，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, surface wind 350 degrees at 3m/s, visibility 8km, ILS approach runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 Hpa.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，地面风350，3米/秒，能见度8千米，盲降进近跑道36右，修正海压1013。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: ILS approach runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 Hpa. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 盲降进近跑道36右，修正海压1013，加航989。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you want to land at runway 18L visually to save time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员，为了节省时间，你想进行目视进近跑道18左。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, request visual approach runway 18L to save time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，为了节约时间，请求目视进近跑道18左。
